messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "may also need to shake your albuterol device just before each use"
set: ["may also need to shake your albuterol device just before each use", "may need to prime your albuterol inhaler device before the first use", "shake the bottle before each use", "use the dose counter on your albuterol inhaler device", "may need to stop use before imaging tests", "you do not need to shake before using", "your heart and blood pressure may also need to be checked often", "must be shaken before each use", "shake bottle vigorously for 5 to 10 seconds prior to each use", "shake oral suspension bottle well for at least 20 seconds before each use", "may need to stop use before surgery, medical procedure, or dental work", "allergy to albuterol", "attach a new needle before each use", "kidney function may need to be checked before taking", "tell your doctor if you also use", "follow all product instructions on how to clean your albuterol inhaler device and mouthpiece"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
